title: Prime Minister shares an article highlighting how dialogue is replacing disputes and trust is strengthening Centre-state relations
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, today shared an article by Chief Minister of Assam, Shri Himanta Biswa Sarma highlighting how dialogue is replacing disputes and trust is strengthening Centre-state relations and development is opening new pathways for progress. The article explores the shift in cooperative federalism realised in the last decade and how far we have come and what we have achieved with belief.
The Prime Minister’s posted on X:
“Dialogue is replacing disputes, trust is strengthening Centre-state relations and development is opening new pathways for progress. In his latest piece, Assam CM Shri @himantabiswa explores the shift in cooperative federalism realised in the last decade. An introspective read as to how far we have come and what we have achieved with belief!
